summary: Tested Merchant Bank & KYC mobile port (Expo/React Native web) at /merchant/bankkyc and its backend APIs end-to-end incl. admin approval flow. All 8 pytest backend tests pass; frontend renders the eligible state (2/2 verified) with PAN approved + primary bank card. Bank form validation (mismatch, invalid IFSC, IFSC uppercase strip) works. Wallet regression /wallet also renders fine (routes are under (merchant) group so URL is /wallet, not /merchant/wallet). Merchant left in approved state with a primary HDFC bank (as requested).
critical_code_review_comments: bankkyc.tsx submit-bank enabling logic is fine (canConfirm covers all required fields) but note: uploadPct.passbook_url being undefined is NOT required in disabled expression; user could tap Submit while passbook is uploading (backend catches it with 400 'Please upload your bank passbook / cheque image'). Suggest adding `|| uploadPct.passbook_url !== undefined || !bank.passbook_url` to Submit disabled for a smoother UX (though the toast surfaces the error).
Confirm mismatch message uses Unicode curly apostrophe (don\u2019t) — matches spec but ensure font renders it correctly on all devices.

runUpload catch reads e.message but api.post throws with e.detail — inconsistent error extraction pattern is used elsewhere (submitPan/submitBank use e?.detail). Harmless because uploadDoc rejects with new Error(detail), but worth aligning.
seed_data_creation: Merchant Sharma Electricals now has approved PAN (ABCDE1234F) + one approved+primary HDFC bank (acc ...1234, IFSC HDFC0001234) so the eligible UI is visible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Merchant panel routes finance-kyc live under /api/merchant/panel/... Admin approves via /api/admin/merchant/{id}/finance/pan/action and /api/admin/merchant/finance/banks/{bank_id}/action. Wallet page URL is /wallet (route group). PAN uppercases + strips non-alphanumerics in input; IFSC uppercases; account_number keyboard is number-pad. Toasts are custom (src/components/Toast.tsx). Merchant is left in the approved state — do not delete the demo merchant or its bank/PAN.
